title: AliKit Command Palette and Dialog matched component probe

benchmark.kind: TestUI component-pipeline probe; not a native renderer or full reference-app benchmark
benchmark.order: 5 fresh processes per revision and component, alternating revision order
benchmark.command_palette: stock controlled palette with three fixed items and its default query
benchmark.dialog: composable modal with title, description, and Cancel/Save actions
benchmark.timing: elapsed wall time around synchronous TestUI description turns; runtime stage timings are measured separately by Alicorn
benchmark.memory: per-process peak resident set size reported by Python resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN); bytes on macOS
